=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:1234-1247 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The raw shard log is `cat`'d unprefixed inside the `::group::` block (lines 1234-1236), so test output starting with `::error::`, `::warning::` or `::add-mask::` runs as a workflow command, and the `| ` prefix covers only the repeated tail.
  WHY: Severity disagreement: sonnet, gemini and glm said NIT, and minimax said NIT in its text; the highest stated severity is NIT, recorded here as medium only if the NIT label is not kept. The same pattern already exists in the merge-train step, so this is not a regression. The comment at 1246-1247 is disputed: sonnet, gemini and minimax say it overstates the protection, and glm says it is accurately scoped.
- changelog.d/8246-ci-heal-job-wiring-shard.md:8-17 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The changelog reports 32 modules in 29.5s, while the ci.yml:1122-1128 comment reports 33 modules in about 31s, and "7 of the 40 modules could not run" implies 33.
  WHY: The record is internally inconsistent and could mislead the next budget-watch decision. All reviewers rated it NIT.
- tests/test_ci_poll_test_sharding.py:1569-1585 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `test_partition_covers_the_real_test_functions` builds IDs from `ast.walk`, which drops the class qualifier, so the partitioned set differs from the real pytest IDs.
  WHY: Sonnet notes the awk `NR % total == n` partition is independent of ID text, so no partition bug is actually hidden. Both rated it NIT. glm rejected the finding as not a detection gap.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:1179-1252 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The fixed `/tmp/wiring_part1_*` paths have no PID or mktemp isolation, so concurrent runs or a module writing to a shared temp path could collide across shards.
  WHY: Sonnet found `rm -f` runs first and no shared writable path in the step, and rated it NIT with confidence 1. Gemini rated it NIT with confidence 2. glm verified the prefixes are disjoint.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:1137-1178 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: Shards are partitioned by line position (`NR % total == n`), not by test duration, so slow tests may cluster in one shard.
  WHY: The wall-clock saving depends on how evenly the slow tests land. Both reviewers rated it NIT. Sonnet notes the sandbox measurement shows a real speedup.
- tests/test_ci_poll_test_sharding.py:WIRING_PART1_MODULES | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The test pins the exact 40-module list and count, so adding a module to `wg1_modules` in ci.yml also requires editing the test.
  WHY: Sonnet says this matches the repo's contract-test convention and the failure is intended. Gemini calls the test fragile. Both rated it NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Move its slowest steps (see the run's step timings) into the CI job with the most headroom, unchanged, keeping job and step names. Do not raise timeout-minutes and do not split tests into new required job names."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/ci.yml, moving steps out of `tests-heal-plan-and-validation` into another existing worker job
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The diff shards the "Regression tests wired by the CI wiring guard (part 1)" step in place into 4 local pytest processes and moves no step to another job. Sonnet treats this as an approved reframe (AD-2, NIT, confidence 2), gemini rates it MAJOR (confidence 5), and minimax calls the move unmet (confidence 4). glm and gpt-6-luna report no gap, and glm sides with the approved AD-2 reframe.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:1234-1247 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The raw shard log is `cat`'d inside the `::group::` block, so `::error::`, `::warning::` or `::add-mask::` lines act as workflow commands. The `| ` prefix is applied only to the repeated tail, so the comment at 1246-1247 overstates the protection. The merge-train step has the same structure, so this is not a regression.
  WHY: A test that prints `::error::...` can add annotations or mask values from the unprefixed first copy of the log.
- changelog.d/8246-ci-heal-job-wiring-shard.md | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The changelog says 32 modules ran in 29.5s, while the ci.yml comment at 1122-1128 says 33 modules in about 31s. 40 minus 7 is 33.
  WHY: There is no runtime effect, but the record is inconsistent.
- tests/test_ci_poll_test_sharding.py:WiringGuardPartOneShardingContractTest.test_partition_covers_the_real_test_functions | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The `module::name` IDs from `ast.walk` drop the class qualifier of unittest methods. The awk partition is independent of ID text, so nothing is lost or duplicated.
  WHY: A partition bug that depends on ID shape would go undetected, but none exists in this awk expression.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:4 concurrent pytest processes | severity=NIT | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: No shared writable path was found in the step, and `rm -f` runs first. A listed module writing to a fixed shared temp path could collide across shards, but none was verified.
  WHY: Not demonstrated.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:awk NR % total == n | severity=NIT | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: Shards are split by line position, not by test duration.
  WHY: Not demonstrated. The sandbox measurement (29.5s serial, 13.0s sharded) shows a real speedup.
- tests/test_ci_poll_test_sharding.py:WIRING_PART1_MODULES and test_module_array_matches_the_constant_and_files_exist | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The test hard-codes the 40-module list and count, so adding a module to `wg1_modules` in ci.yml requires editing the test.
  WHY: This matches the repo's contract-test convention, and the failure is the intended outcome.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Move its slowest steps (see the run's step timings) into the CI job with the most headroom, unchanged, keeping job and step names. Do not raise timeout-minutes and do not split tests into new required job names."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/ci.yml, moving steps out of `tests-heal-plan-and-validation`.
  Evidence of absence: The PR shards the step in place and moves no step. Auto-decision AD-2 (REFRAME) covers this, and the reviewer treats it as an approved reframe, not an unmet requirement. Job and step names are unchanged, `timeout-minutes` is not raised, and no new required job name is added.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:1235, 1246-1247 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The raw `cat` of shard logs emits workflow commands such as `::error::` or `::warning::`. The `| ` prefix in the tail does not protect the main log block.
  WHY: Malicious or accidental test output can be interpreted by the runner as workflow commands.
- tests/test_ci_poll_test_sharding.py:1569-1585 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The partition test uses `ast.walk`, which does not resolve TestCase class methods correctly.
  WHY: The test validates against an incorrect set of IDs, which could mask partition errors for class-based tests.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:1179-1180, 1208-1252 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The step uses hard-coded `/tmp/wiring_part1_*` paths without PID or mktemp isolation.
  WHY: Concurrent or nested runs would collide on files and give invalid test results.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:1137-1178 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Shards are partitioned by line number (`NR % total`), not by test duration.
  WHY: Heavy modules might cluster in one shard and become the bottleneck, negating the speedup.
- changelog.d/8246-ci-heal-job-wiring-shard.md:9 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The changelog states 32 modules in the table row, while the ci.yml comment says 33. "7 of 40 could not run" implies 33.
  WHY: Documentation drift could mislead future operators diagnosing CI timings.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Move its slowest steps (see the run's step timings) into the CI job with the most headroom, unchanged, keeping job and step names."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/ci.yml
  Evidence of absence: The diff shards the step in place within the existing job instead of moving it to a job with more headroom.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "The test pins the exact 40-module list and the hard-coded count 40." (Implied requirement for maintenance)
  Expected change site: tests/test_ci_poll_test_sharding.py
  Evidence of absence: The test lists all 40 modules and pins the count to 40, so it is fragile and needs updating whenever the suite composition changes.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:`cat "${wg1_stem}.log" || true` inside the `::group::` block | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The full shard log is `cat`'d raw inside `::group::`/`::endgroup::`, and GitHub parses workflow commands on every stdout line. The `| ` prefix protects only the 40-line tail outside the groups, so the inline comment overstates the protection.
  WHY: A failing test that prints text starting with `::` would inject a workflow command into the CI summary or annotations. The merge-train step has the same pattern.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Move its slowest steps (see the run's step timings) into the CI job with the most headroom, unchanged, keeping job and step names. Do not raise `timeout-minutes` and do not split tests into new required job names."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/ci.yml, the `tests-heal-plan-and-validation` job's slowest step(s) moved into another existing worker job.
  Evidence of absence: No step leaves `tests-heal-plan-and-validation`. The diff shards the step in place into 4 local pytest processes. AD-2 is labelled "REFRAME" and chose an option outside its listed alternatives A, B and C. The ci.yml comment says "no other job with headroom" without naming the job it tried. The sharding is an in-place mitigation, not the requested move.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
